$comment: Names 0.31 removed, which a changelog section or upgrade page for an EARLIER version may still use
(tooling/scripts/docs-verify/history.mjs). `generated` is written by removed-names.mjs from the
API-surface diff between `base` and the banked contracts/server.api.txt — do not hand-edit it.
`reviewed` lists removals that surface cannot see, each with its reason; edit it by hand, and keep
it short: every entry is a name history may use without the verifier asking.

reviewed.name: collection
reviewed.reason: The data layer's by-slug accessor, `client.data.collection(slug)` (and `rebase.data.collection(slug)` on the server), renamed `table(slug)` in 0.31. The data layer is a type alias, which the API surface records without members, so the diff cannot see it.
